objects.definition: struct ImPlotContext;             // ImPlot context (opaque struct, see implot_internal.h)
objects.description: Opaque ImPlot context object holding all library state. Only forward-declared here; definition is internal. Used with CreateContext/DestroyContext/GetCurrentContext/SetCurrentContext.
Axis selector/index type for addressing plot axes. Typedef is an int with associated enum ImAxis_ enumerators.

objects.definition:

objects.definition:

objects.description: Flags for configuring subplot grids in BeginSubplots.
Legend display and behavior flags used by SetupLegend.
Flags controlling the mouse position text overlay formatting/visibility.
Flags controlling behavior of drag tools like DragPoint/DragLine/DragRect.
Flags for rendering a colormap scale widget.
Per-item flags applicable to most plotting primitives to control legend and fit participation.
Flags to modify line plotting behavior and rendering.
Flags that affect scatter plotting (e.g., clipping markers).
Flags for stairs plot styling and step orientation.
Flags for shaded plot fill behavior (placeholder).
Flags for bar chart orientation and behavior.
Flags for grouped bar charts.
Flags for error bars orientation.
Flags for stem plots (orientation).
Flags for infinite reference lines.
Flags for pie chart behavior and labeling.
Flags affecting heatmap data layout.
Flags for 1D/2D histogram configuration.
Flags for digital plots (placeholder).
Flags for image items in plots (placeholder).
Flags for oriented plot text rendering.
Flags for dummy plot items (placeholder).
Condition specifier for API that sets state (analogous to ImGuiCond subset).

objects.description: Bitfield specifying 2D locations for legends, mouse text, etc.
Enumeration of automatic histogram binning strategies, stored in int typedef.
Double-precision 2D point used throughout ImPlot for coordinates and getters. Provides constructors and index operators.
1D numeric range with helpers for containment, size, and clamping. Used for axes limits and histogram ranges.
Axis-aligned rectangle composed of X and Y ranges. Commonly used for plot limits and selections with utility methods.
Complete style configuration for ImPlot including sizes, paddings, colors array, colormap selection, and time formatting options. Constructed with defaults via constructor.
Remappable input bindings for plot interactions (pan/select/fit/menu/zoom) including optional modifier keys and zoom rate. Constructed with defaults.

objects.definition: typedef int (*ImPlotFormatter)(double value, char* buff, int size, void* user_data);
objects.description: Callback typedef for custom axis tick/label formatting. Returns number of characters written.

objects.definition: typedef ImPlotPoint (*ImPlotGetter)(int idx, void* user_data);
objects.description: Callback typedef that returns an ImPlotPoint for index-based data retrieval used by PlotXxxG functions.

objects.definition: typedef double (*ImPlotTransform)(double value, void* user_data);
objects.description: Callback typedef for user-defined axis forward/inverse transforms used by SetupAxisScale with custom transforms.
Obsolete flags kept for backward compatibility; scheduled for removal.

functions.name: ImPlot::CreateContext
functions.description: Creates a new ImPlot context. Call after ImGui::CreateContext when using ImPlot standalone from ImGui.
requirements: Must be called after ImGui::CreateContext if using separate setup.
Returns a new ImPlotContext which can be made current with SetCurrentContext or destroyed with DestroyContext.

functions.name: ImPlot::DestroyContext
functions.description: Destroys an ImPlot context. If ctx is nullptr, destroys the current context.
requirements: Call before ImGui::DestroyContext.
If ctx is nullptr, a current ImPlot context must exist.
Do not use the context after destruction.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetCurrentContext
functions.description: Returns the current ImPlot context or nullptr if none is set.
requirements: None beyond having created a context to receive a non-null result.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetCurrentContext
functions.description: Sets the current ImPlot context to ctx.
requirements: ctx must be a valid ImPlotContext created by CreateContext or nullptr to clear.
Should be set appropriately when using multiple contexts.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetImGuiContext
functions.description: Sets the current ImGui context for ImPlot. Only necessary when ImPlot is built/used as a DLL separate from ImGui.
requirements: Only required when ImPlot is used via a shared library separate from ImGui.
ctx must be a valid ImGuiContext pointer.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginPlot
functions.signature: bool BeginPlot(const char* title_id, const ImVec2& size = ImVec2(-1,0), ImPlotFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Starts a 2D plotting context. Returns true if a plot is started; if true, EndPlot must be called. Use inside an if (BeginPlot(...)) { ... EndPlot(); } block.
requirements: title_id must be unique within the current ImGui ID scope (use "##hidden" to avoid displaying a title).
Call EndPlot exactly once if and only if this returns true.
size is the plot frame size; ImVec2(0,0) uses style default.
Setup API calls for axes/legend/etc. should be made immediately after successful BeginPlot and before plotting.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginPlot
functions.signature: bool BeginPlot(const char* title_id, const char* x_label, const char* y_label, const ImVec2& size = ImVec2(-1,0), ImPlotFlags flags = ImPlotFlags_None, ImPlotAxisFlags x_flags = 0, ImPlotAxisFlags y_flags = 0, ImPlotAxisFlags y2_flags = ImPlotAxisFlags_AuxDefault, ImPlotAxisFlags y3_flags = ImPlotAxisFlags_AuxDefault, const char* y2_label = nullptr, const char* y3_label = nullptr);
functions.description: Deprecated overload (OBSOLETED in v0.13; planned removal). Starts a plot with inline axis labels/flags. Returns true if started; must EndPlot if true.
requirements: Deprecated API; prefer the current BeginPlot + Setup* API.
Call EndPlot exactly once if and only if this returns true.
title_id uniqueness rules still apply.

functions.name: ImPlot::EndPlot
functions.description: Ends a plot previously started with BeginPlot.
requirements: Must only be called if the preceding BeginPlot returned true.
Must match a prior BeginPlot call in the same scope.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginSubplots
functions.signature: bool BeginSubplots(const char* title_id, int rows, int cols, const ImVec2& size, ImPlotSubplotFlags flags = 0, float* row_ratios = nullptr, float* col_ratios = nullptr);
functions.description: Starts a subdivided plotting context (grid of plots). Returns true if the subplot context starts; if true, EndSubplots must be called.
requirements: title_id must be unique within the current ImGui ID scope (use double-hash to hide).
rows and cols must be > 0.
Call EndSubplots exactly once if and only if this returns true.
Within the context, call BeginPlot/EndPlot at most rows*cols times, in row-major order unless ColMajor flag is set.
size specifies total grid size; BeginPlot size is ignored inside.
If provided, row_ratios must have at least rows elements and col_ratios at least cols; the arrays must remain valid during the context and may be modified by the API.

functions.name: ImPlot::EndSubplots
functions.description: Ends a subplot context started by BeginSubplots.
requirements: Must only be called if the preceding BeginSubplots returned true.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxis
functions.signature: void SetupAxis(ImAxis axis, const char* label = nullptr, ImPlotAxisFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Enables/configures an axis on the current plot, setting label and/or flags.
requirements: Must be called after a successful BeginPlot and before plotting/SetupFinish.
Pass label = nullptr for no label.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisLimits
functions.signature: void SetupAxisLimits(ImAxis axis, double v_min, double v_max, ImPlotCond cond = ImPlotCond_Once);
functions.description: Sets an axis range limits. If ImPlotCond_Always is used, limits are locked. Inversion via v_min > v_max is not supported here; use SetupAxisScale/other means.
requirements: Call only during Setup stage (after BeginPlot, before plotting or SetupFinish).
v_min must be <= v_max (inversion not supported by this function).

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisLinks
functions.signature: void SetupAxisLinks(ImAxis axis, double* link_min, double* link_max);
functions.description: Links an axis range to external variables, enabling two-way synchronization.
requirements: Call during Setup stage (after BeginPlot, before plotting/SetupFinish).
link_min and/or link_max may be nullptr to unlink that bound; non-null pointers must remain valid until EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisFormat
functions.signature: void SetupAxisFormat(ImAxis axis, const char* fmt);
functions.description: Sets numeric axis label formatting using a printf-style format string (values are double).
requirements: Call during Setup stage.
fmt must be a valid printf-style format for double (e.g., %g, %f).

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisTicks
functions.signature: void SetupAxisTicks(ImAxis axis, const double* values, int n_ticks, const char* const labels[] = nullptr, bool keep_default = false);
functions.description: Manually sets axis tick positions and optional labels.
requirements: Call during Setup stage.
values must point to an array of at least n_ticks doubles and remain valid for the setup call.
If labels is provided, it must have at least n_ticks C-strings; each may be nullptr for default formatting.
If keep_default is true, default ticks are kept in addition to provided ones.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisScale
functions.description: Sets an axis scaling using built-in scales (Linear, Time, Log10, SymLog).
requirements: Call during Setup stage.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisLimitsConstraints
functions.signature: void SetupAxisLimitsConstraints(ImAxis axis, double v_min, double v_max);
functions.description: Constrains the axis limits to the provided min/max while interacting or fitting.
requirements: Call during Setup stage.
v_min should be <= v_max to be meaningful.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxisZoomConstraints
functions.signature: void SetupAxisZoomConstraints(ImAxis axis, double z_min, double z_max);
functions.description: Constrains the axis zoom scale (min/max visible range) to [z_min, z_max].
requirements: Call during Setup stage.
z_min should be <= z_max to be meaningful.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxes
functions.signature: void SetupAxes(const char* x_label, const char* y_label, ImPlotAxisFlags x_flags = 0, ImPlotAxisFlags y_flags = 0);
functions.description: Convenience to set labels/flags for primary X and Y axes (equivalent to two SetupAxis calls).
requirements: Call during Setup stage.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupAxesLimits
functions.signature: void SetupAxesLimits(double x_min, double x_max, double y_min, double y_max, ImPlotCond cond = ImPlotCond_Once);
functions.description: Sets the limits for primary X and Y axes. With ImPlotCond_Always, limits are locked.
requirements: Call during Setup stage.
x_min <= x_max and y_min <= y_max.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupLegend
functions.description: Configures legend location and behavior for the current plot or shared-items subplot.
requirements: Call during Setup stage.
When in subplots with ShareItems, this may be called immediately after BeginSubplots.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupMouseText
functions.description: Configures the mouse position text location and behavior for the current plot.
requirements: Call during Setup stage.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetupFinish
functions.description: Explicitly finalizes plot setup. After calling, further Setup calls for the current plot are disallowed.
requirements: Optional; if not called, the first plotting or utility call will finalize automatically.
Call only after BeginPlot and before plotting; once called, do not call other Setup* functions.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextAxisLimits
functions.signature: void SetNextAxisLimits(ImAxis axis, double v_min, double v_max, ImPlotCond cond = ImPlotCond_Once);
functions.description: Preconfigures the next plot's axis limits for a given axis.
requirements: Must be called outside of any Begin/EndPlot block.
Non-default axes must still be enabled with SetupAxis for this to take effect.
If ImPlotCond_Always is used, limits will be locked.
v_min <= v_max.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextAxisLinks
functions.signature: void SetNextAxisLinks(ImAxis axis, double* link_min, double* link_max);
functions.description: Preconfigures linkage of the next plot's axis limits to external variables.
requirements: Must be called outside of any Begin/EndPlot block.
link_min and/or link_max may be nullptr; non-null pointers must remain valid until the corresponding EndPlot.
Non-default axes must be enabled with SetupAxis.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextAxisToFit
functions.description: Marks an upcoming axis to auto-fit to its data.
requirements: Must be called outside of any Begin/EndPlot block.
Non-default axes must be enabled with SetupAxis for this to apply.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextAxesLimits
functions.signature: void SetNextAxesLimits(double x_min, double x_max, double y_min, double y_max, ImPlotCond cond = ImPlotCond_Once);
functions.description: Preconfigures the next plot's primary X and Y axis limits.
requirements: Must be called outside of any Begin/EndPlot block.
If ImPlotCond_Always is used, limits will be locked.
x_min <= x_max and y_min <= y_max.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextAxesToFit
functions.description: Preconfigures the next plot so all axes auto-fit their data.
requirements: Must be called outside of any Begin/EndPlot block.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotLineG
functions.signature: void PlotLineG(const char* label_id, ImPlotGetter getter, void* data, int count, ImPlotLineFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots a line using a user-supplied point getter callback.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
getter must be a valid function returning ImPlotPoint for idx in [0, count).
data is passed through to getter and may be nullptr; it must remain valid for the call.
count must be >= 0.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotScatterG
functions.signature: void PlotScatterG(const char* label_id, ImPlotGetter getter, void* data, int count, ImPlotScatterFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots a scatter series using a user-supplied point getter.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
getter/data/count validity as for PlotLineG.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotStairsG
functions.signature: void PlotStairsG(const char* label_id, ImPlotGetter getter, void* data, int count, ImPlotStairsFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots a stairstep series using a user-supplied point getter.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
getter/data/count validity as for PlotLineG.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotShadedG
functions.signature: void PlotShadedG(const char* label_id, ImPlotGetter getter1, void* data1, ImPlotGetter getter2, void* data2, int count, ImPlotShadedFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots a shaded region between two series provided by two getters, or between a series and a reference if one side encodes it.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
getter1/getter2 must be valid for indices [0, count).
data1/data2 must remain valid for the call; may be nullptr.
count must be >= 0.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotBarsG
functions.signature: void PlotBarsG(const char* label_id, ImPlotGetter getter, void* data, int count, double bar_size, ImPlotBarsFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots a bar series (vertical by default) using a user-supplied point getter.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
getter/data/count validity as for PlotLineG.
bar_size is in plot units and should be non-negative for meaningful rendering.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotDigitalG
functions.signature: void PlotDigitalG(const char* label_id, ImPlotGetter getter, void* data, int count, ImPlotDigitalFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots a digital (step-like) series using a user-supplied getter. Digital plots are pinned to plot bottom and ignore y zoom/drag.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
getter/data/count validity as for PlotLineG.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotImage
functions.signature: void PlotImage(const char* label_id, ImTextureRef tex_ref, const ImPlotPoint& bounds_min, const ImPlotPoint& bounds_max, const ImVec2& uv0 = ImVec2(0, 0), const ImVec2& uv1 = ImVec2(1, 1), const ImVec4& tint_col = ImVec4(1, 1, 1, 1), ImPlotImageFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Plots an axis-aligned image with given texture reference. bounds_min/max are in plot coordinates (y-up); uv0/uv1 are texture coordinates (y-down).
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
tex_ref must be a valid texture reference.
bounds_min and bounds_max define the image rectangle in plot units.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotText
functions.signature: void PlotText(const char* text, double x, double y, const ImVec2& pix_offset = ImVec2(0,0), ImPlotTextFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Draws centered text at plot position (x,y) with optional pixel offset and flags.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
text must be a valid C-string pointer for the duration of the call.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotDummy
functions.signature: void PlotDummy(const char* label_id, ImPlotDummyFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Adds a dummy plot item (e.g., to create a legend entry colored by ImPlotCol_Line).
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
label_id is used for legend entry identification.

functions.name: ImPlot::DragPoint
functions.signature: bool DragPoint(int id, double* x, double* y, const ImVec4& col, float size = 4, ImPlotDragToolFlags flags = 0, bool* out_clicked = nullptr, bool* out_hovered = nullptr, bool* out_held = nullptr);
functions.description: Renders an interactive draggable point at (x,y). Returns true when the point is moved; outputs click/hover/hold states if provided.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
id should be a persistent identifier unique within the plot.
x and y must be valid pointers to modifiable doubles alive for the call.
out_* pointers are optional.

functions.name: ImPlot::DragLineX
functions.signature: bool DragLineX(int id, double* x, const ImVec4& col, float thickness = 1, ImPlotDragToolFlags flags = 0, bool* out_clicked = nullptr, bool* out_hovered = nullptr, bool* out_held = nullptr);
functions.description: Renders an interactive vertical guide line at x. Returns true when x changes; outputs click/hover/hold states if provided.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
id should be unique and stable within the plot.
x must be a valid pointer to a modifiable double.

functions.name: ImPlot::DragLineY
functions.signature: bool DragLineY(int id, double* y, const ImVec4& col, float thickness = 1, ImPlotDragToolFlags flags = 0, bool* out_clicked = nullptr, bool* out_hovered = nullptr, bool* out_held = nullptr);
functions.description: Renders an interactive horizontal guide line at y. Returns true when y changes; outputs click/hover/hold states if provided.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
id should be unique and stable within the plot.
y must be a valid pointer to a modifiable double.

functions.name: ImPlot::DragRect
functions.signature: bool DragRect(int id, double* x1, double* y1, double* x2, double* y2, const ImVec4& col, ImPlotDragToolFlags flags = 0, bool* out_clicked = nullptr, bool* out_hovered = nullptr, bool* out_held = nullptr);
functions.description: Renders an interactive draggable/resizable rectangle with corners (x1,y1)-(x2,y2). Returns true when any coordinate changes.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
id should be unique and stable within the plot.
x1,y1,x2,y2 must be valid pointers to modifiable doubles.

functions.name: ImPlot::Annotation
functions.signature: void Annotation(double x, double y, const ImVec4& col, const ImVec2& pix_offset, bool clamp, bool round = false);
functions.description: Renders an annotation callout at (x,y) with color col and pixel offset. Can clamp to plot area and optionally round positioning.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::AnnotationV
functions.signature: void AnnotationV(double x, double y, const ImVec4& col, const ImVec2& pix_offset, bool clamp, const char* fmt, va_list args);
functions.description: Renders a formatted text annotation callout using a va_list.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
fmt must be valid and args must be a valid va_list for the format.

functions.name: ImPlot::TagX
functions.signature: void TagX(double x, const ImVec4& col, bool round = false);
functions.description: Shows a tag on the x-axis at value x.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::TagXV
functions.signature: void TagXV(double x, const ImVec4& col, const char* fmt, va_list args);
functions.description: Shows a formatted tag on the x-axis at value x using a va_list.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
fmt and args must be valid for each other.

functions.name: ImPlot::TagY
functions.signature: void TagY(double y, const ImVec4& col, bool round = false);
functions.description: Shows a tag on the y-axis at value y.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::TagYV
functions.signature: void TagYV(double y, const ImVec4& col, const char* fmt, va_list args);
functions.description: Shows a formatted tag on the y-axis at value y using a va_list.
requirements: Must be called between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
fmt and args must be valid for each other.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetAxis
functions.description: Selects which axis will be used for subsequent plot items for either X or Y depending on index.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot before plotting the items to be affected.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetAxes
functions.description: Selects which X and Y axes indices will be used for subsequent plot items.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot before plotting the items to be affected.

functions.name: ImPlot::PixelsToPlot
functions.signature: ImPlotPoint PixelsToPlot(const ImVec2& pix, ImAxis x_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO, ImAxis y_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Converts a pixel position to plot coordinates for the specified or current axes.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot for the current plot state to be valid.

functions.name: ImPlot::PlotToPixels
functions.signature: ImVec2 PlotToPixels(const ImPlotPoint& plt, ImAxis x_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO, ImAxis y_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Converts a plot coordinate to pixel coordinates for the specified or current axes.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot for the current plot state to be valid.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetPlotPos
functions.description: Returns the top-left position of the current plot area in pixels.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetPlotSize
functions.description: Returns the size of the current plot area in pixels.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetPlotMousePos
functions.signature: ImPlotPoint GetPlotMousePos(ImAxis x_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO, ImAxis y_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Returns the mouse position in the current plot's coordinates for the specified or current axes.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetPlotLimits
functions.signature: ImPlotRect GetPlotLimits(ImAxis x_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO, ImAxis y_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Returns the current visible axis ranges for the specified or current axes.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::IsPlotHovered
functions.description: Returns true if the plot area of the current plot is hovered.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::IsAxisHovered
functions.description: Returns true if the specified axis label area in the current plot is hovered.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::IsSubplotsHovered
functions.description: Returns true if the bounding frame of a subplot is hovered.
requirements: Call between BeginSubplots and EndSubplots.

functions.name: ImPlot::IsPlotSelected
functions.description: Returns true if the current plot is being box-selected.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetPlotSelection
functions.signature: ImPlotRect GetPlotSelection(ImAxis x_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO, ImAxis y_axis = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Returns the current plot box-selection bounds in plot coordinates for the specified or current axes.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Meaningful only if IsPlotSelected is true.

functions.name: ImPlot::CancelPlotSelection
functions.description: Cancels the current plot box selection.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::HideNextItem
functions.signature: void HideNextItem(bool hidden = true, ImPlotCond cond = ImPlotCond_Once);
functions.description: Hides or shows the next plot item as if toggled from the legend.
requirements: Call immediately before plotting the item you want to hide/show.
Use ImPlotCond_Always to force every frame if needed.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginAlignedPlots
functions.signature: bool BeginAlignedPlots(const char* group_id, bool vertical = true);
functions.description: Begins an alignment group for multiple plots so padding aligns across a row/column. Returns true if started; if true, call EndAlignedPlots.
requirements: group_id must be unique for the alignment group.
Call EndAlignedPlots exactly once if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::EndAlignedPlots
functions.description: Ends an aligned plots group started by BeginAlignedPlots.
requirements: Must only be called if the preceding BeginAlignedPlots returned true.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginLegendPopup
functions.signature: bool BeginLegendPopup(const char* label_id, ImGuiMouseButton mouse_button = 1);
functions.description: Begins a popup context menu for a legend entry identified by label_id. Returns true if the popup is open; if true, you must call EndLegendPopup.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
label_id must match an existing legend item label.
Call EndLegendPopup if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::EndLegendPopup
functions.description: Ends a legend popup begun by BeginLegendPopup.
requirements: Must only be called if the preceding BeginLegendPopup returned true.

functions.name: ImPlot::IsLegendEntryHovered
functions.description: Returns true if the legend entry for label_id is hovered.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
label_id must match an existing legend item label.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginDragDropTargetPlot
functions.description: Turns the current plot's plotting area into a drag-and-drop target. Returns true if a target is active; if true, call EndDragDropTarget.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Call EndDragDropTarget if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginDragDropTargetAxis
functions.description: Turns the specified axis of the current plot into a drag-and-drop target. Returns true if active; if true, call EndDragDropTarget.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Call EndDragDropTarget if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginDragDropTargetLegend
functions.description: Turns the current plot's legend into a drag-and-drop target. Returns true if active; if true, call EndDragDropTarget.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Call EndDragDropTarget if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::EndDragDropTarget
functions.description: Ends a drag-and-drop target (alias of ImGui::EndDragDropTarget).
requirements: Must be called if a corresponding BeginDragDropTarget* returned true.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginDragDropSourcePlot
functions.description: Turns the current plot's plotting area into a drag-and-drop source. Returns true if active; if true, call EndDragDropSource.
requirements: By default requires holding the Ctrl modifier (OverrideMod in input map) to initiate.
Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Call EndDragDropSource if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginDragDropSourceAxis
functions.description: Turns the specified axis into a drag-and-drop source. Returns true if active; if true, call EndDragDropSource.
requirements: By default requires holding the Ctrl modifier to initiate.
Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Call EndDragDropSource if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::BeginDragDropSourceItem
functions.signature: bool BeginDragDropSourceItem(const char* label_id, ImGuiDragDropFlags flags = 0);
functions.description: Turns an item in the plot legend into a drag-and-drop source. Returns true if active; if true, call EndDragDropSource.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
label_id must match an existing legend item label.
Call EndDragDropSource if and only if this returns true.

functions.name: ImPlot::EndDragDropSource
functions.description: Ends a drag-and-drop source (alias of ImGui::EndDragDropSource).
requirements: Must be called if a corresponding BeginDragDropSource* returned true.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetStyle
functions.description: Provides access to the global ImPlotStyle for permanent modifications to colors, sizes, and settings.
requirements: None.

functions.name: ImPlot::StyleColorsAuto
functions.description: Applies the Auto style (matching current ImGui style) to ImPlot colors, writing to dst if provided or the current style otherwise.
requirements: If dst is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotStyle.

functions.name: ImPlot::StyleColorsClassic
functions.description: Applies the Classic color style to ImPlot, writing to dst if provided or the current style otherwise.
requirements: If dst is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotStyle.

functions.name: ImPlot::StyleColorsDark
functions.description: Applies the Dark color style to ImPlot, writing to dst if provided or the current style otherwise.
requirements: If dst is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotStyle.

functions.name: ImPlot::StyleColorsLight
functions.description: Applies the Light color style to ImPlot, writing to dst if provided or the current style otherwise.
requirements: If dst is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotStyle.

functions.name: ImPlot::PushStyleColor
functions.description: Temporarily override a style color by 32-bit RGBA. Must be balanced with PopStyleColor.
requirements: Every PushStyleColor must be matched with a PopStyleColor to avoid leaks.
idx must be a valid ImPlotCol enum value.

functions.name: ImPlot::PopStyleColor
functions.description: Reverts temporary style color overrides. Can pop multiple at once.
requirements: count must be the number of outstanding PushStyleColor calls to revert (>= 1).

functions.name: ImPlot::PushStyleVar
functions.description: Temporarily override a float style variable. Must be balanced with PopStyleVar.
requirements: Every PushStyleVar must be matched with PopStyleVar.
idx must be a valid ImPlotStyleVar and type must match (float).

functions.name: ImPlot::PopStyleVar
functions.description: Reverts temporary style variable overrides. Can pop multiple at once.
requirements: count must be the number of outstanding PushStyleVar calls to revert (>= 1).

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextLineStyle
functions.signature: void SetNextLineStyle(const ImVec4& col = IMPLOT_AUTO_COL, float weight = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Sets the line color and weight for the next plotted item only.
requirements: Call immediately before the item you want to affect.
Leave values as IMPLOT_AUTO/IMPLOT_AUTO_COL to auto-deduce.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextFillStyle
functions.signature: void SetNextFillStyle(const ImVec4& col = IMPLOT_AUTO_COL, float alpha_mod = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Sets the fill color (and optional alpha modifier) for the next plotted item only.
requirements: Call immediately before the item to affect.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextMarkerStyle
functions.signature: void SetNextMarkerStyle(ImPlotMarker marker = IMPLOT_AUTO, float size = IMPLOT_AUTO, const ImVec4& fill = IMPLOT_AUTO_COL, float weight = IMPLOT_AUTO, const ImVec4& outline = IMPLOT_AUTO_COL);
functions.description: Sets marker style for the next plotted item only.
requirements: Call immediately before the item to affect.

functions.name: ImPlot::SetNextErrorBarStyle
functions.signature: void SetNextErrorBarStyle(const ImVec4& col = IMPLOT_AUTO_COL, float size = IMPLOT_AUTO, float weight = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Sets error bar style for the next plotted item only.
requirements: Call immediately before the item to affect.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetLastItemColor
functions.description: Returns the primary color used by the most recently submitted item (its legend icon color).
requirements: Call after at least one item has been submitted to the plot for a meaningful value.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetStyleColorName
functions.description: Returns the null-terminated name string for an ImPlotCol.
requirements: idx must be a valid ImPlotCol.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetMarkerName
functions.description: Returns the null-terminated name string for an ImPlotMarker.
requirements: idx must be a valid ImPlotMarker.

functions.name: ImPlot::AddColormap
functions.signature: ImPlotColormap AddColormap(const char* name, const ImVec4* cols, int size, bool qual = true);
functions.description: Adds a new colormap from an array of ImVec4 colors. Name must be unique. Returns the colormap index.
requirements: name must be unique.
size must be > 1.
cols must point to at least size colors; data is copied.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetColormapCount
functions.description: Returns the total number of available colormaps (built-in plus user-added).
requirements: None.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetColormapName
functions.description: Returns the name for a colormap index, or nullptr if invalid.
requirements: cmap must be a valid colormap index to get a non-null result.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetColormapIndex
functions.description: Returns the index for a colormap by name, or -1 if not found.
requirements: name must be a non-null C-string.

functions.name: ImPlot::PushColormap
functions.description: Temporarily switches to a colormap by index. Must be balanced with PopColormap.
requirements: Every PushColormap must be matched with a PopColormap.
cmap should be a valid colormap index.

functions.name: ImPlot::PopColormap
functions.description: Reverts temporary colormap changes. Can pop multiple at once.
requirements: count must be the number of outstanding PushColormap calls to revert (>= 1).

functions.name: ImPlot::NextColormapColor
functions.description: Returns the next color from the current colormap and advances it for the current plot. Must be called between Begin/EndPlot.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot to affect/reflect the current plot's colormap iterator.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetColormapSize
functions.description: Returns the number of colors in a colormap (current if IMPLOT_AUTO).
requirements: cmap must refer to a valid colormap or be IMPLOT_AUTO.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetColormapColor
functions.signature: ImVec4 GetColormapColor(int idx, ImPlotColormap cmap = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Returns a color from a colormap by index (modulo colormap size).
requirements: cmap must refer to a valid colormap or be IMPLOT_AUTO.
idx >= 0; modulo is applied.

functions.name: ImPlot::SampleColormap
functions.signature: ImVec4 SampleColormap(float t, ImPlotColormap cmap = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Samples a color from a colormap by parameter t in [0,1].
requirements: t should be in [0,1] for expected behavior.
cmap must refer to a valid colormap or be IMPLOT_AUTO.

functions.name: ImPlot::ColormapScale
functions.signature: void ColormapScale(const char* label, double scale_min, double scale_max, const ImVec2& size = ImVec2(0,0), const char* format = "%g", ImPlotColormapScaleFlags flags = 0, ImPlotColormap cmap = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Shows a color scale widget with ticks using the specified colormap. If scale_min > scale_max, the mapping is reversed.
requirements: label can be hidden with double hashes.
scale_min and scale_max define the numeric range; reversed mapping if min > max.

functions.name: ImPlot::ColormapSlider
functions.signature: bool ColormapSlider(const char* label, float* t, ImVec4* out = nullptr, const char* format = "", ImPlotColormap cmap = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Shows a horizontal slider with a colormap gradient background. Optionally outputs the sampled color at t. Returns true if value changed.
requirements: t must be a valid pointer to a float in [0,1] for expected behavior.
out is optional and, if provided, must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: ImPlot::ColormapButton
functions.signature: bool ColormapButton(const char* label, const ImVec2& size = ImVec2(0,0), ImPlotColormap cmap = IMPLOT_AUTO);
functions.description: Shows a button filled with the specified colormap gradient. Returns true when pressed.
requirements: None.

functions.name: ImPlot::BustColorCache
functions.description: Forces items to resample their color from the current colormap by clearing cached colors. If plot_title_id is nullptr, applies to all plots; otherwise only to the matching plot in the same ID scope.
requirements: If plot_title_id is non-null, must be called in the same ImGui ID scope as the target plot title.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetInputMap
functions.description: Returns the global input mapping structure for modifying pan/select/zoom controls.
requirements: None.

functions.name: ImPlot::MapInputDefault
functions.description: Sets the default input mapping (pan=LMB drag, select=RMB drag, fit=LMB double-click, menu=RMB click, zoom=scroll).
requirements: If dst is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotInputMap; otherwise modifies the global map.

functions.name: ImPlot::MapInputReverse
functions.description: Sets the reverse input mapping (pan=RMB drag, select=LMB drag, fit=LMB double-click, menu=RMB click, zoom=scroll).
requirements: If dst is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotInputMap; otherwise modifies the global map.

functions.name: ImPlot::ItemIcon
functions.description: Renders a small legend-like item icon with the given color (useful in custom UIs).
requirements: Call in a valid ImGui window/draw context.

functions.name: ImPlot::ColormapIcon
functions.description: Renders an icon representing a colormap.
requirements: cmap must be a valid colormap index.
Call in a valid ImGui window/draw context.

functions.name: ImPlot::GetPlotDrawList
functions.description: Returns the ImDrawList used for custom rendering to the current plot area.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::PushPlotClipRect
functions.description: Pushes a clip rect corresponding to the current plot area, expanded or contracted by expand pixels, for custom drawing.
requirements: Call between BeginPlot and EndPlot.
Must be paired with PopPlotClipRect.

functions.name: ImPlot::PopPlotClipRect
functions.description: Pops the plot clip rect pushed by PushPlotClipRect.
requirements: Must be paired with a prior PushPlotClipRect within Begin/EndPlot.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowStyleSelector
functions.description: Shows an ImPlot style selector combo box. Returns true if a style was selected/applied.
requirements: label must be a valid C-string.
Call within an ImGui frame.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowColormapSelector
functions.description: Shows a colormap selector combo box. Returns true if selection changed/applied.
requirements: label must be a valid C-string.
Call within an ImGui frame.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowInputMapSelector
functions.description: Shows an input-map selector UI. Returns true if changes were made.
requirements: label must be a valid C-string.
Call within an ImGui frame.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowStyleEditor
functions.description: Shows the ImPlot style editor UI block. If ref is provided, shows a reference style for comparison.
requirements: Call within an ImGui frame.
If ref is non-null, it must point to a valid ImPlotStyle.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowUserGuide
functions.description: Displays a basic help/information block for end users.
requirements: Call within an ImGui frame.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowMetricsWindow
functions.description: Displays the ImPlot metrics/debug window. Optionally controlled by p_popen.
requirements: Call within an ImGui frame.
p_popen may be nullptr or point to a bool controlling window open state.

functions.name: ImPlot::ShowDemoWindow
functions.description: Displays the ImPlot demo window (requires adding implot_demo.cpp to your sources).
requirements: Call within an ImGui frame.
p_open may be nullptr or point to a bool controlling window open state.

data_types.description: An arbitrary UTF-8/byte string with no specific format constraints. May include any characters, including null bytes if passed via std::string.c_str() only for the portion up to the first null. Used for labels, titles, and tick labels in these stubs.
